RegionId-C-000-C.Description: The RegionId column adheres to the following requirements

RegionId-D-001-C.Description: RegionId MUST be present in a FOCUS dataset when the provider supports deploying resources or services within a region

RegionId-C-002-M.Description: RegionId MUST be of type String

RegionId-C-003-M.Description: RegionId MUST conform to StringHandling requirements

RegionId-C-004-M.Description: RegionId nullability is defined as follows

RegionId-C-005-C.Condition: Resource or service is operated in or managed from a distinct region
RegionId-C-005-C.Description: RegionId MUST NOT be null when a resource or service is operated in or managed from a distinct region

RegionId-C-006-C.Condition: Resource or service is not operated in or managed from a distinct region
RegionId-C-006-C.Description: RegionId MAY be null when a resource or service is not operated in or managed from a distinct region
